insights.description: Separate series for historical Basic Pitch Light and new MuScriptor Small Light. New MuScriptor events begin after the frontend deployment; historical events remain unchanged. Preview and tagged tests excluded.

source.query: SELECT coalesce(nullIf(toString(properties.transcription_backend_method), ''), nullIf(toString(properties.transcription_model_implementation), ''), multiIf(coalesce(nullIf(toString(properties.transcription_model_id), ''), toString(properties.transcriptionModel)) = 'msmodel_small', 'msmodel_small', coalesce(nullIf(toString(properties.transcription_model_id), ''), toString(properties.transcriptionModel)) = 'light', 'basic_pitch', coalesce(nullIf(toString(properties.transcription_model_id), ''), toString(properties.transcriptionModel)) = 'heavy', 'yourmt3', coalesce(nullIf(toString(properties.transcription_model_id), ''), toString(properties.transcriptionModel)) = 'super_heavy', 'msmodel', 'unknown')) AS model, count() AS starts FROM events WHERE coalesce(toString(properties.environment), '') != 'preview' AND coalesce(toString(properties.is_test), 'false') != 'true' AND event='transcription_started' AND timestamp >= now() - INTERVAL 30 DAY GROUP BY model ORDER BY starts DESC

insights.description: Starts by actual model implementation: basic_pitch (legacy Light), msmodel_small (new Light), yourmt3 (retired Medium), msmodel (Heavy). Historical ids are mapped at query time. Preview and tagged test traffic excluded.

source.query:
SELECT model, duration_bucket, input_source, count() AS users, sum(did_return_d7) AS retained_users, round(sum(did_return_d7) / count(), 3) AS d7_retention FROM (
 SELECT model, duration_bucket, input_source, first_start_at,
 arrayExists(t -> toDate(t) > toDate(first_start_at) AND t <= first_start_at + INTERVAL 7 DAY, activity_times) AS did_return_d7
 FROM (
 SELECT person_id, minIf(timestamp, event = 'transcription_started') AS first_start_at,
 argMinIf(coalesce(nullIf(toString(properties.transcription_backend_method), ''), nullIf(toString(properties.transcription_model_implementation), ''), multiIf(coalesce(nullIf(toString(properties.transcription_model_id), ''), toString(properties.transcriptionModel)) = 'msmodel_small', 'msmodel_small', coalesce(nullIf(toString(properties.transcription_model_id), ''), toString(properties.transcriptionModel)) = 'light', 'basic_pitch', coalesce(nullIf(toString(properties.transcription_model_id), ''), toString(properties.transcriptionModel)) = 'heavy', 'yourmt3', coalesce(nullIf(toString(properties.transcription_model_id), ''), toString(properties.transcriptionModel)) = 'super_heavy', 'msmodel', 'unknown')), timestamp, event = 'transcription_started') AS model,
 argMinIf(multiIf(coalesce(toFloat(properties.durationSec), 0) <= 30, '0-30s', coalesce(toFloat(properties.durationSec), 0) <= 120, '31-120s', coalesce(toFloat(properties.durationSec), 0) <= 300, '121-300s', '300s+'), timestamp, event = 'transcription_started') AS duration_bucket,
 argMinIf(coalesce(nullIf(toString(properties.input_source), ''), nullIf(toString(properties.mode), ''), 'unknown'), timestamp, event = 'transcription_started') AS input_source,
 groupArrayIf(timestamp, event IN ('transcription_started', 'transcription_succeeded', 'transcription_imported_to_editor', 'gte_session_started', 'gte_practice_started', 'gte_editor_saved', 'product_home_viewed')) AS activity_times
 FROM events WHERE timestamp >= now() - INTERVAL 90 DAY AND coalesce(toString(properties.environment), '') != 'preview' AND coalesce(toString(properties.is_test), 'false') != 'true'
 GROUP BY person_id HAVING countIf(event = 'transcription_started') > 0
 )
 WHERE first_start_at <= now() - INTERVAL 7 DAY
) GROUP BY model, duration_bucket, input_source ORDER BY users DESC LIMIT 100

insights.description: Observational D7 comparison by model implementation, duration and source. Legacy Light maps to basic_pitch; new Light is msmodel_small. Cohorts require a complete seven-day window. No historical events are rewritten. Preview and tagged tests excluded.
